summary: {member} offers the budget chair another way to raise the money without adding the same charge to every round.
realLife: Portland council adopted the Novick and Green amendments replacing a proposed five-dollar golf surcharge with a fund transfer and a revised pricing plan.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: a proposed surcharge, alternative schedule and transfer target.

turns.pulledBy: A uniform increase would put the same dollar charge on a cheaper junior round.
turns.what: The member offers a schedule with different increases.
turns.writesBack: The amendment records which rates change.

turns.pulledBy: The council reduces the projected take from rounds.
turns.what: The budget chair asks how much of the transfer can still be covered.
turns.writesBack: The budget draft shows the remaining gap.
